stem: Which detail from the section “Effective Eyewear” supports the key idea that ancient snow goggles were long-lasting?

options.label: A
options.text: Ancient snow goggles improved the vision of those who had trouble seeing.

options.label: B
options.text: The slit in ancient snow goggles focused the light so that distant objects appeared clearer.

options.label: C
options.text: The bone used in ancient snow goggles was stronger than the plastic used for modern sunglasses.

options.label: D
options.text: Modern sunglasses are more likely to fog up than ancient snow goggles were.
